cause: Tire upper envelope reaches z=.68, while hood/deck behind the open pockets is lower. Narrow rolled arch tubes do not span the tread width; source and low mesh expose far-side tire half-moons.
fix: Replace tube faces with four closed fender shoulders, joining actual coachwork inboard and spanning over tread with open lower arches. Existing body/UVs/wheel meshes/cameras are retained.
